chapter: Learning the drums and early influences
title: High school playing with no practice, and the first big bass drum
summary: He did not practice, played stock arrangements, and describes his first huge bass drum, later made into a coffee table.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
